proposal.summary: The data_upsell campaign has a clearly positive past lift (+0.93 points, 95% +0.76 to +1.09), but all segment comparisons are not clearly different, so there is no basis to narrow or exclude. Contact pressure is notable: 26,343 lines (25%) were contacted in the last 7 days and 1,652 already had 3 or more campaigns in 30 days.

proposals.title: Keep the audience as it is
proposals.rationale: No segment is clearly different for data_upsell, so narrowing or excluding would not be supported by the facts. The SMS channel matches the past data_upsell campaigns that were sent by SMS, and the recent-contact and cap figures are points to consider rather than grounds for a change.

proposals.title: Consider recent contact pressure before sending
proposals.rationale: 26,343 lines (25%) got a campaign in the last 7 days and 1,652 already had 3 or more campaigns in the last 30 days. These lines may be fatigued, so the team could decide whether to hold them back.
